rows.07:1e22c: That was enough of the third-floor classrooms for now.
rows.07:1e9d8:
I bent down to pick up the mechanical pencil.
Fukuzawa kicked straight up at my face, shoe and all.{p}
rows.07:1eb30:
Along with the pale yellow liquid, blood ran down, one trickle, then two.
She licked it off with a flick of her tongue and laughed.
"Game over."
No...
This can't be happening.
After everything I went through, this is the end?
Am I just going to die now?
"Oh, I love that look on your face. Come on, show me more! Show me how much it stings to lose. Give me that I-want-to-live face."
Fukuzawa said gleefully.
Her eyes were sparkling.
She really seemed to be having the time of her life.
As I stared at her, a pitch-black rage swelled up inside me.{p}
rows.07:1efe8:
A sharp, stabbing pain shot through my palm.
The shock of the fall had broken the ampoule.
Desperately, I licked up the yellow liquid as it ran out with my blood.
Behind me, Fukuzawa laughed.
"Kyahahaha, no use, no use.
They say you have to drink the whole dose of that antidote, or it's pointless.
If you only drink a little, it actually makes the poison work faster."{p}
rows.07:1f118:
What?
As I tried to turn around, the strength drained softly out of me.
My body went numb.
Is this the poison taking effect?
"It's working already? Lord Hino really is amaaazing."
Fukuzawa's delighted voice.
But by then, I couldn't even see her anymore.
After I'd come this far...
Before I even had time to grind my teeth, my consciousness sank into darkness.{p}
rows.07:1f324:
Then, in one swift motion, she drove it into my eye.
A shock like a red-hot poker rammed all the way into the center of my brain.
I couldn't even tell whether I was screaming or not.
The pain felt like my brain was being churned, and I could only writhe helplessly.
The next instant, the finishing blow came down on me.{p}
rows.07:1f908:
Meeting nothing but air, I fell to the hallway floor.
The next instant, something burning hot was thrust into my neck.
Like a switch had been flipped off, the strength drained out of my body.
I can't stand...?
And what is this?
This stuff flowing out of my neck...{p}
rows.07:1fe80:
When I came to my senses, Kazama was lying right beside me.
The kitchen knife was buried deep in his chest.
What an anticlimactic way to die.
But strangely, it seemed to suit Kazama.
Come on, there's no time to dawdle.{p}
rows.07:20298:
"I'm so glad you asked.
You see, people build up this thing called stress.
But the elite must never let stress build up. So what do you do about it?
That's right. You eliminate anything that might cause you stress.
You kill every last person who makes you angry.
That way, stress never builds up, and whatever stress you have just naturally melts away.
It's fun. Is there any other method as wonderful as this?"
"You're out of your mind."
"...Thank you. I'll take that as a compliment.
Ordinary people never understand what a genius thinks. It's been that way in every age.
Now, time to end this."{p}
